scoring_justification: Compare agent's reported half-contrast depths to paper-derived reference values, with internal consistency check from contrast curve to enforce simulation provenance. T0 is used because raw simulation fields are not submitted, preventing full recompute from first principles.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference half-contrast depths for periods 200,140,80,20 nm derived from paper's Fig.5 approximate digital extraction, plus contrast threshold for 20 nm period exit plane.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.5 and Fig.4. Values approximated by reading plots.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted by visual inspection of paper's Fig.5 (half-contrast depth vs period) yielding approximate depths: 200 nm -> ~35 nm, 140 nm -> ~24 nm, 80 nm -> ~14 nm, 20 nm -> ~3.5 nm. Contrast at exit plane >0.5 from Fig.4 for 20 nm period.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are realistic approximations from the paper's published plots, sufficient to verify plausibility of agent's simulation results with generous tolerances.

outputs.description: Contrast V = (Ia-Is)/(Ia+Is) as a function of depth behind the grating for the 20 nm period case. The checker will compare the reported contrast at selected depths and verify that contrast at the exit plane exceeds a threshold.

Depth where contrast first drops below 0.5 for each grating period. The checker will compare these depths to hidden reference values and verify the linear relationship between period and half-contrast depth.

output_contract.notes: The scored artifacts are derived entirely from the agent's own simulation data. No paper-specific constants beyond the public chrome permittivity and geometry are required. The checker uses hidden reference values extracted from the paper to evaluate accuracy with appropriate tolerances.
